en.name: Electrode
en.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

fr.name: Électrode
fr.description: Plus il accumule de l’énergie de type Électrik, plus il est rapide. Mais il a aussi davantage de chances d’exploser.

es.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Autodestrucción
attacks.effect: Este Pokémon también se hace 90 puntos de daño a sí mismo.

it.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Finale

attacks.name: Autodestruição

zh-tw.description: 蓄積的電能越多，移動的速度也會變得越快，但同時也會變得更容易爆炸。
